content: {"reasoning":"The claim cannot be submitted successfully as-is because Meridian considers the CPT/diagnosis pairing invalid, and repeating correction without a supported diagnosis risks another failed touch. There is no denial or information request supporting appeal, peer review, or document submission, while retro authorization is both unnecessary and unavailable because authorization is already on file. A specialist must review the clinical record and determine whether a supported diagnosis correction is possible before timely filing expires.","action":"escalate"}
